facts.name: Steven M. Fahlgren
facts.assignment: Nassau Circuit Court, Division A; published guide covers civil and family matters, with separate probate/guardianship and remote-hearing supplements.

contact.contact_note: Guide lists both physical locations; confirm hearing venue from the notice. Telephone is shared with the judicial assistant; no separate personal judge email or fax established.

chambers_communications.summary: Email the assistant with case number, case name and matter; copy all parties unless legally authorized ex parte. Do not copy the assistant on scheduling negotiations.

hearing_scheduling.summary: File the motion first, coordinate all parties and requested time, then obtain court confirmation before noticing. Available dates are not held. Confirm cancellations with the assistant.

conferral.summary: Confer with the other side on hearing duration and availability; observe applicable conferral rules and the official guide.

proposed_orders.summary: Submit Word orders through the portal with an agreement/disagreement cover letter and actual service addresses; guide states ten days after hearing. It separately prefers emailed competing evidentiary orders. Consult the source for formatting and exceptions.

courtesy_copies.summary: Required hearing materials reach the court three business days before hearing, copied to parties. Submit electronically; over 50 pages also require hard copies to the Yulee office. See source for applicability.

remote_appearances.summary: Guide states requests by motion alongside default Zoom for civil/family hearings unless in-person notice is filed and emailed three business days before. Separate foreclosure link/addendum; preserve both statements and follow the hearing notice.

conflicts: Primary guide states remote requests by motion while also providing default Zoom for civil/family matters; addenda repeat default Zoom. Statements preserved without choosing controlling authority.
Previously reviewed templates use CCCC while primary guide requires actual Copies-to addresses. Prior evidence retained at4033; templates not promoted as a general current submission instruction.
gaps: No separately published personal judge email or fax in the checked roster/guide; assistant contact is the office route.

review_scope.collected: Primary17-page guide freshly retrieved; identical SHA256 to October11 original. Prior four core source originals/text and4033review retained.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Contacts and recurring communications/scheduling/remote/order/courtesy-copy requirements on pages1–8; basic remote addenda. Prior review reused without repeating its specialized analysis.
review_scope.not_reviewed: No renewed review of trial calendars, forms, family/probate merits or motion-specific litigation recipes. Shared county/circuit rules remain county-stage work.
